## spaceman event connection

Pulse connections: list, show, add, update and delete.

Aliases: `connections`, `conn`.

|---|---|
| [`spaceman event connection create`](#spaceman-event-connection-create) | Add a Pulse connection |

## spaceman event connection create

Add a Pulse connection.

```sh
spaceman event connection create [flags]
```

API: `create-event-connection` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman event connection create --name pulse --url tls://pulse.example.com:4222 --enabled --creds-file spaceman.creds
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ca-file` | string |  | PEM file of the CA that signs the server certificate |
| `--creds-file` | string |  | Pulse .creds file of the client (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--creds-stdin` | bool |  | read --creds-file's value from standard input instead |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--stream` | string |  | JetStream stream |
| `--url` | string |  | NATS URL of the Pulse server |

## spaceman event connection delete

Delete an unused Pulse connection.


API: `delete-event-connection` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman event connection update

Edit a Pulse connection; --creds-file replaces its credentials.

```sh
spaceman event connection update <connection> [flags]
```

API: `get-event-connection`, `update-event-connection` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ca-file` | string |  | PEM file of the CA that signs the server certificate |
| `--creds-file` | string |  | Pulse .creds file of the client (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--creds-stdin` | bool |  | read --creds-file's value from standard input instead |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--stream` | string |  | JetStream stream |
| `--url` | string |  | NATS URL of the Pulse server |

## spaceman event subscription create

Subscribe the space to events of a connection.

```sh
spaceman event subscription create [flags]
```

API: `create-subscription` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--connection` | string |  | connection ID (required) |
| `--custom-file` | string |  | custom template definition (JSON or YAML file) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--follow` | string |  | pinned or latest |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--start-file` | string |  | start cursor (JSON or YAML file) |
| `--template-version` | string |  | template version ID |
| `--var` | string, repeatable |  | template variable (key=value, repeatable) |

## spaceman event subscription replay

Replay a subscription's events from a point (recorded with a reason).

```sh
spaceman event subscription replay <subscription> [flags]
```

API: `get-subscription`, `replay-subscription` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman event subscription replay --space payments sub_01... --policy time --time 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z \
  --reason "template bug dropped PR events"
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--fresh-items` | bool |  | create new inbox items even for events already delivered |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--policy` | string |  | all, time or seq (required) |
| `--reason` | string |  | why (required, recorded in the audit log) |
| `--seq` | integer |  | with seq: stream sequence to replay from |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--time` | string |  | with time: RFC 3339 point to replay from |
